steps.say: The lead checks the hospital system first, then hands the work out to the medicines and transport agents, by their jobs in the room.
The transport agent books for when the medicines will actually be ready, not as soon as possible.
The agents check each other's work, in plain sight of the team.
And nothing leaves the room without a nurse's yes, on Switch's approval card.
And when an update is vague, the lead won't record it until it knows who did what, and when. Every entry has a name on it.
